scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const nextDir = path.resolve('.next'); const rootNext = path.resolve('../../.next'); if (!fs.existsSync(rootNext) && fs.existsSync(nextDir)) { try { fs.symlinkSync(nextDir, rootNext, 'junction'); console.log('Linked .next to repo root for Vercel'); } catch (e) { try { fs.cpSync(nextDir, rootNext, { recursive: true }); console.log('Copied .next to repo root for Vercel'); } catch(err) { console.error('Failed to link .next to root:', err); } } } if (fs.existsSync(path.join(nextDir, 'routes-manifest.json')) && !fs.existsSync(path.join(nextDir, 'routes-manifest-deterministic.json'))) { try { fs.copyFileSync(path.join(nextDir, 'routes-manifest.json'), path.join(nextDir, 'routes-manifest-deterministic.json')); } catch(e){} } if (fs.existsSync(rootNext) && fs.existsSync(path.join(rootNext, 'routes-manifest.json')) && !fs.existsSync(path.join(rootNext, 'routes-manifest-deterministic.json'))) { try { fs.copyFileSync(path.join(rootNext, 'routes-manifest.json'), path.join(rootNext, 'routes-manifest-deterministic.json')); } catch(e){} }"
